GX008 supports matched negative controls and broad product analysis. Transfer is limited because no supplied evidence shows a non-sacrificial base reproducing the target Co-bpy photocatalysis; any rescue is therefore descriptive evidence for partial proton-management contribution only.","groups":[{"id":"E16G01","description":"Primary TEOA baseline in the P01 Co-bpy/g-C3N4 assay.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"TEOA present"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G02","description":"Amine omission control with baseline otherwise retained.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G03","description":"No amine plus one pre-screened non-donor base selected by pilot for minimal background reactivity and minimal visible disruption of the Co-bpy/g-C3N4 mixture.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"pre-screened non-donor base present"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G04","description":"TEA comparator under the same platform.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"TEA present"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]}],"comparisons":[{"group_a":"E16G01","group_b":"E16G02","changed_factors":["amine_condition"],"inference":"Omission test for whether an amine is required under the TEOA baseline; does not separate donor redox from proton-management roles."},{"group_a":"E16G02","group_b":"E16G03","changed_factors":["base_condition"],"inference":"Tests whether a carefully screened non-donor base shifts activity or CO/H2 distribution relative to no amine; any rescue is bounded evidence for proton-management contribution, not amine equivalence."},{"group_a":"E16G01","group_b":"E16G04","changed_factors":["amine_condition"],"inference":"Direct TEA versus TEOA comparison within one platform; remains a multi-role additive identity contrast, not single-mechanism proof."},{"group_a":"E16G03","group_b":"E16G04","changed_factors":["amine_condition","base_condition"],"inference":"Confounded descriptive contrast between TEA and a non-donor-base condition; useful only to bound how much behavior can be approached without an amine donor."}],"procedure":["Verify the P01 baseline composition from the supplied scope, then pre-screen candidate non-donor bases in the same solvent matrix using blank and compatibility checks before selecting one replacement condition.","Prepare the four listed groups with identical catalyst, ligand, g-C3N4, solvent ratio, reactor geometry, CO2 handling, irradiation schedule, and analytical workflow; vary only the stated factors.","Run photocatalysis under CO2 with matched sampling and quantify CO and H2 for every group using the same calibrated gas-analysis method.","Record a bulk acid-base descriptor if measurable in the chosen medium and note obvious precipitation, color change, or phase instability as comparability flags.","Interpret results only through the specified contrasts and treat any non-donor-base rescue as partial descriptive evidence unless it reproducibly approaches an amine-containing baseline under matched controls."],"measurements":["CO amount or rate by the common gas-analysis workflow","H2 amount or rate by the same workflow","CO/H2 ratio or selectivity metric from paired CO and H2 data","Bulk acid-base descriptor before and after reaction if measurable in the chosen medium","Qualitative observations of precipitation, color change, or phase separation as comparability checks"],"supports":"H03 is supported if amine omission strongly suppresses or shifts the baseline behavior and the pre-screened non-donor base causes a reproducible partial movement in total activity or CO/H2 distribution toward the TEOA case, while TEA and TEOA still differ under matched conditions.","refutes":"H03 is weakened if the non-donor base produces no reproducible shift relative to no amine and TEA versus TEOA differences remain large under otherwise matched conditions, especially if omission mainly removes activity in a way consistent with loss of donor function alone.","inconclusive":"Inconclusive if the selected base causes new background reactivity, instability, or phase changes; if acid-base conditions cannot be compared meaningfully; or if product signals are near detection limits.","parameter_selection":"Do not invent concentrations. Use the verified P01 baseline for TEA and TEOA conditions. For the replacement arm, first screen candidate non-donor bases in the same solvent matrix and choose one condition only if it meets all pilot criteria: negligible CO and H2 in catalyst-free or no-light blanks, no obvious decomposition or precipitation before irradiation, and a measurable change in a bulk acid-base descriptor relative to E16G02. If no candidate meets these criteria, retain only E16G01/E16G02/E16G04 and report the replacement arm as blocked.","limitations":"The replacement arm remains limited because a non-donor base cannot reproduce sacrificial electron donation. Positive rescue can also reflect ionic-strength, coordination, viscosity, or solvation changes. Negative rescue cannot exclude proton-management contributions. Bulk acid-base descriptors in MeCN/H2O may not represent local proton delivery. This card therefore tests necessity and bounded medium sensitivity, not full causal separation.","feasibility":"low_cost"}]}
